engine.name: Unity (IL2CPP)

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse of the launcher plus directory inventory of Replanted_Data
staticAnalysis.limits: The managed game code is IL2CPP inside GameAssembly.dll; its service strings have not been enumerated yet, so 'no online dependency' is not claimed.

notes: Steam entitlement is the platform gate every Steam title in this registry shares, so it is not modelled as a restorable external service: the licence and Steam Offline Mode are the supported path and nothing here bypasses them. Next step is a dependency pass over GameAssembly.dll and a measured offline launch.
